title: I-20 Fort Worth photos
text: 2025 status: These 2007 photos remain accurate for the main lanes. In 2026 work was completed to add two new intersections on this segment of I-20, at the future Walsh Ranch Parkway and the future Bentley Drive (see image below).

images.caption: This TxDOT graphic shows the improvements added to this section of I-20, which includes new intersections at the future Walsh Ranch Parkway and the future Bentley Drive. This project (Project 1 in the graphic) began in August 2023 and was scheduled to be completed by early 2026.
Looking east, west of Markum Ranch Road
Downtown Fort Worth is visible in the distance
There are two or three unused overpasses over I-20, inaccessible by vehicle. I parked on the main lanes shoulder and walked up to this overpass.
Looking east toward the Interstate 820 interchange.
